issues.negative-litres: The past watering form on /beds and POST /api/waterings accept a negative amount such as -5 litres, save it, report success, and list it as a negative amount on /waterings.
issues.water-now-twice: Double-clicking the 'Water now' button on /beds sends two POST /api/waterings requests and records two identical waterings because the button is not disabled while its request runs.
issues.waterings-page-crash-non-list-response: When GET /api/waterings returns a non-array body (such as an empty object), the /waterings page throws 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function', never renders, and leaves the previous page on screen with no error shown.
issues.tiny-litres-saved-shown-as-zero: Submitting the past watering form on /beds with a tiny amount such as 0.004 litres saves it despite the field's 0.1 minimum and shows it as '0 L' in the notice and the waterings list.
issues.dashboard-waterings-error-no-retry: When the dashboard's Recent waterings section fails to load, it shows only error text with no retry control.
issues.dashboard-malformed-waterings-not-shown-: When GET /api/waterings?limit=5 returns a malformed non-list body, the dashboard's Recent waterings section shows 'No waterings yet' or garbage rows reading 'Never' instead of an error.
issues.unknown-bed-filter-select-mismatch: Opening /waterings?bed= with an unknown bed id filters the list to 'No waterings for this bed' while the Bed select shows no selection, so the select and the list disagree.
issues.year-1-date-accepted: The past watering form on /beds and POST /api/waterings accept an absurd date such as 0001-01-01 and record it as 'Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1.'
issues.waterings-page-error-no-retry: When the /waterings page fails to load, it shows only the error text with no retry control, so a page reload is needed.
issues.water-now-shared-pending-state-across-be: Clicking 'Water now' on two beds in quick succession on /beds re-enables the second bed's button while its request is still running and loses the first bed's notice, because one shared pending bed id is cleared when the first request finishes.
